name: flow_race_mode_turns_open_seats_off
description: Open seats are a one-team mode's (design 5.2): the queue fills a High Water party's open seats with strangers but finds a race a rival team. The leader turns them on in High Water and the empty rows read '+ open seat'; a switch to Tide Race turns them off (PARTY_STATE's flag, as the server's mode change does), so the race's empty rows read '+ invite' and the hidden toggle leaves nothing on; back in High Water they stay off until the leader turns them on again.

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', '+ open seat', '+ open seat', '+ open seat'] and node('OpenSeats').text == 'open seats: on'
steps.msg: High Water: the empty rows are open seats
the switch to a race turned them off

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['A diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', '+ invite', '+ invite', '+ invite'] and not node('OpenSeats').visible
steps.msg: a race's empty rows invite; no toggle
a race finds a rival team
open seats cannot be turned on in a race

steps.assert: not Session.open_seats() and node('OpenSeats').visible and node('OpenSeats').text == 'open seats: off' and node('HubPanel').lines()[1] == '+ invite'
steps.msg: back in High Water, off until the leader turns them on
a party of one without open seats plays at once
